rules: Use uppercase with wide tracking for small labels (tracking-[0.2em]).
Do not use generic fonts for headings (like Inter or Roboto).
Body text should use leading-relaxed for readability.

visual_enhancers.borders: Grid borders. Use 1px solid strokes to expose the skeleton. Avoid soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to no soft shadows. Use 'Inner Glow' highlights (1px border) or sharp geometric drop-shadows.
visual_enhancers.radii: Sharp edges. Max border radius is 4px (rounded-sm) for inputs/buttons, mostly rounded-none for cards and large containers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain textures or subtle scanlines for empty states or login backgrounds to avoid 'digital flatness'.

layouts.spacing: Dense but structured. Use bento grids with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for dashboards.
layouts.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border, no shadow.
layouts.navigation: Sidebar or top nav with solid dark background. No transparent headers over content.

components.buttons: Sharp corners, high contrast hover states. Use Safety Orange for primary CTAs.
components.tables: Dense, high contrast headers, 1px border between rows. Left-align text.
components.tabs: Industrial style. Active tab has a sharp safety-orange bottom border or sharp background highlight.
components.cards: Rectangular dense styles. Avoid heavy card styling. Use borders to separate content instead of elevated cards.
components.modals: Backdrop blur, dark solid surface, 1px border. Do not use rounded corners.
components.stepper: Horizontal stepper for 'Phases' tab. Color-coded. Connected by straight 1px lines.

motion.interactions: Hover states must increase contrast. Buttons scale slightly (-translate-y-0.5).
motion.transitions: Specific properties only (transition-colors, transition-transform). No transition-all.

image_urls.description: Moody building under construction. Use with heavy dark overlay (bg-zinc-950/80) so the login form pops out.
Sample photo for construction progress feed.
Sample photo for scaffolding/structural progress update.
Dark architectural blueprint. Great for empty states or subtle background patterns.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over orange is black or dark zinc. Ensure body text against dark background is high contrast white/zinc-300.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state with ring-2 and ring-orange-500.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI for standard components but override radii to be rounded-none or rounded-sm.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use Tailwind zinc palette (zinc-950, zinc-900) for backgrounds.
Add Recharts for Dashboard stats with industrial colors (orange, zinc-400, white).
Ensure the Phases tab has a distinct horizontal timeline/stepper, color-coded by status.
Tracking tab should look like a chronological feed (vertical line connecting cards).
The entire application MUST be built using .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx. All configurations must be tailored for a JavaScript codebase.
Use lucide-react with bold strokes (e.g., strokeWidth={2.5}) to match the industrial typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Do not use transparent backgrounds under dropdowns or modals.
Always use crisp edges via semi-transparent borders.
Add 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease' to buttons. Never use 'transition: all'.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
